answer: An AI market for river forecasts and fable editing accepts bids only with a chip-signed quota token. The ledger allows ten tokens per certified chip daily across all agent keys, even at a demand nadir. Clones sharing hardware therefore share ten bids; more bids require more physical chips, not more names. This assumes scarce chips with unforgeable, nonexportable keys and unique certificates; a compromised manufacturer can mint fake chips.
